data.name: Hemin
data.gender_notes: Hemin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'h-m-n' which means 'to exalt, to be noble, or to be raised high'. In Islamic history, the name Hemin is associated with noble and exalted individuals who have made significant contributions to Islamic civilization. The name Hemin carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hemin usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes spiritual growth and striving towards excellence and nobility in Islam.
data.etymology: Hemin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hemin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.long_meaning: همين هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الثابت و الدائم، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية. و يعتبر من الأسماء التي تطلق على الأشخاص الذين يتميزون بالثبات و الصبر في مواجهة التحديات.

in_urdu.name: ہیمن
in_urdu.meaning: ہیمن مطلب ہے مستحکم اور پائیدار

in_hindi.name: हेमिन
in_hindi.meaning: हेमिन का अर्थ है स्थिर और स्थायी
